header.name: Workunit
header.description: The central manufacturing resource model that represents a specific piece of equipment, machine, or production station capable of executing manufacturing processes. Workunits are the fundamental building blocks of the production floor and serve as the primary constraint resources in scheduling and execution.

modelDefinition.name: Workunit

fields.name: id
fields.description: The primary unique ID of the record.  Every model should have an id field.

fields.name: code
fields.description: (String!, Required, Unique): Business-friendly unique identifier used for operational reference

fields.name: changeoverPlcCode
fields.description: Workunit specific PLC Code - must be an integer value. IF generic codes can be used, then configure them in the mode table and not at the indivudual workunit. If this is not populated, system will look the code up at the mode table. If no code is found, no system changes will be made by the plc.

fields.name: concurrency
fields.description: (Int, Optional, Default: 1): Maximum number of simultaneous work orders this workunit can process

fields.name: unitPerCycle
fields.description: (Int!, Optional, Default: 1): Number of units produced per machine cycle

fields.name: hourlyLaborCost
fields.description: (Float!, Required, Default: 0): Standard labor cost per hour for operations on this workunit

fields.name: hourlyOverheadCost
fields.description: (Float!, Required, Default: 0): Standard labor cost per hour for operations on this workunit

fields.name: hourlySetupCost
fields.description: (Float!, Required, Default: 0): Cost per hour during setup/changeover activities

fields.name: productionOperators
fields.description: (Float, Optional, Default: 0): Number of production operators required during normal operations

fields.name: setupOperators
fields.description: (Float, Optional, Default: 0): Number of operators required during setup/changeover activities

fields.name: standardRate
fields.description: (Float, Optional, Default: 0): Default production rate (units per hour) when workunit-specific rates are enabled

fields.name: active
fields.description: (Boolean!, Required, Default: true): System flag controlling whether the workunit is available for production assignments

fields.name: constraint
fields.description: (Boolean!, Required, Default: true): Boolean flag indicating if this workunit should be considered during scheduling optimization

fields.name: ospType
fields.description: (Boolean, Optional, Default: false): Indicates if this workunit handles outside processing operations

fields.name: productionType
fields.description: (Boolean, Optional): Indicates if this workunit performs production operations

fields.name: description
fields.description: (String, Optional): Detailed explanation of the workunit's purpose and capabilities

fields.name: externalId
fields.description: (String, Optional): Integration field linking to external systems (ERP, PLCs, etc.)

fields.name: name
fields.description: (String!, Required): Human-readable label for the workunit

fields.name: customData
fields.description: A collection of extra data points that can vary depending on the source of the workunits.

fields.name: cycleDuration
fields.description: cycle time in seconds per unit of production (actual machine cycle)

fields.name: processDuration
fields.description: Process duration - the fixed amount of time required to perform this process, also used for OSP lead time.

fields.name: setupDuration
fields.description: (Duration, Optional): Standard time required for equipment setup between different products

fields.name: standardDuration
fields.description: (Duration, Optional): Time per unit of production for standard operations

fields.name: transitAfter
fields.description: Transit time required after performing this process.

fields.name: transitBefore
fields.description: Transit time required before beginning this process.

fields.name: scheduleGroupId
fields.description: (ID!, Required, Default: "Default"): Schedule group for resource planning and optimization

fields.name: scheduleGroup
fields.description: (ID!, Required, Default: "Default"): Schedule group for resource planning and optimization

fields.name: workcenterId
fields.description: (ID!, Required): Parent workcenter that contains this workunit

fields.name: workcenter
fields.description: (ID!, Required): Parent workcenter that contains this workunit

fields.name: controlPanelScreen
fields.description: Control panel screens must contain 'control panel' in their name

fields.name: currentProductionRunId
fields.description: (ID, Optional, Unique): Reference to the active production run, if any

fields.name: currentProductionRun
fields.description: (ID, Optional, Unique): Reference to the active production run, if any

fields.name: iDocumentDesign
fields.description: Inventory label format design

fields.name: distributions
fields.description: Link to work order process ditribution

fields.name: workunitStateHistories
fields.description: seconds per unit of production ideal - used for OEE.
